title: PAU Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Tractor Operator Posts
description: The Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) has released the official notification for the recruitment of 01 Tractor Operator. Candidates who have passed the 10th can grab this chance and apply for the PAU Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
